in_sanskrit.name: Gouse
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Protector
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gouse एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Gouse is derived from the Sanskrit word 'go' which means 'cow' and the Sanskrit word 'sahas' which means 'protector'. Thus, the name Gouse signifies a protector of cows or an individual who embodies the qualities of courage and strength associated with the cow.
